classificationDefinitions.covered: Behind the active modal or context menu. Reactions are removed; the foreground owner controls dismissal and return.
classificationDefinitions.wired: The native reaction defines this finite action. See destination and trigger; a native edge alone is not browser verification.
classificationDefinitions.inherited-action: Child visual belonging to an ancestor action; it is not a separate command.
classificationDefinitions.label-or-readonly-text: Text label or fixed fixture value. This layer does not independently execute an action.
classificationDefinitions.site-content: Website-content fixture inside the editor/visual preview, not an editor command. Visitor scripts and delivery are not executed.
classificationDefinitions.structural-display: Selection outline, section heading or table structure, not an independent command.
classificationDefinitions.readonly-field: Fixed field/search specimen. Arbitrary text entry, validation and document writes are not simulated in this scene; the displayed value is retained.
classificationDefinitions.action-container: Container holding separately accounted child actions, not an additional command.
classificationDefinitions.disabled-state: Uses the shared disabled button variant. The state-specific label/nearby explanation and scope note define why it cannot execute.
classificationDefinitions.finite-scene-limit: Explicitly unavailable in this finite scene and visually muted. The named action has no matching state/caller fixture here; use the named representative start for its supported journey. This is a prototype restriction, not product permission enforcement.
classificationDefinitions.geometry-specimen: Static resize handle. Continuous pointer geometry, transactions, snapping and live Undo require the editor engine; no resize operation is executed.
classificationDefinitions.menu-command-limit: Static, muted Arrange command. Runtime sibling order/eligibility and mutation are defined in PHASE6-CONTROL-CONTRACTS.md; this demo validates menu ownership, collision and cancellation only.
classificationDefinitions.design-specimen: Static component/state specification board, not an application journey or live command.
classificationDefinitions.frame-keyboard: Screen-level native keyboard reaction; browser evidence is credited only when the specific Escape path was traversed.
classificationDefinitions.frame-no-keyboard: Screen root with no generic keyboard handler. Only explicitly linked temporary tasks support Escape in this finite prototype.
classificationDefinitions.scope-link: Opens the visible, domain-specific prototype restriction note without a product-side mutation.
classificationDefinitions.scope-return: Returns from the scope note using Figma BACK, or Escape. Restores the exact source fixture, including its retained panel/draft/sample state.
classificationDefinitions.hidden-retained: Inside an invisible collapsed panel. The inherited reaction exists but cannot be reached in this screen; it is not counted as visible interaction coverage.
